title: About me
text:
I am currently a machine learning software engineer in Health Artificial Intelligence (AI) team at Google. My main duties includes applying foundatinal AI research into practical applications in Google products.
I also have strong research background with publications at top venues, such as NeurIPS and ICLR. My research focuses on dialogue management, with specific applications in recommendation systems and, more recently, behavior change. Please visit my Google Scholar page for details.
Interests: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence, Human-Robot Interaction, Natural Language Processing, Reinforcement Learning, Social Impact.
